artifacts.summary: Design decision: presentation (a), the set-valued per-state datum as the maximum certified subset of Q x ClType x K, over (b) a parameter-coupled tuple index (dominated, incomplete, barred); two findings -- the certified chains of record are region-interior and never Rlad histories (compiled), and any computable datum's counter quotient is forced to the six-coordinate shape with parameters as outputs of the pumping lemma; the counter-lift lemma named as the open problem on which viability rests.

next_steps: Plan task 761 against this decision: file the counter-lift lemma (obligations 2+3) as a gated research-first record before any sufficiency attempt; rebuild cohBi across idle steps on the carrier Q x ClType x K with certStab per (q, kappa); state LadderCons as certAdm plus maximality; never state a tuple as the index.

memory_candidates.content: The ladder's certified realizability (coh/cohBi, certAdm, Realizes) is region-interior: coh requires pend at both endpoints, so every Realizes chain is an all-pending object walk, and no forward Rlad ray is pending for more than c0+1 steps (exists_idle_of_rlad_ray). Label-level sufficiency over cohBi composes to ladder realizability only through a counter-lift lemma across idle runs under Count/Drift.

Carrier coordinate vs index: a counter quotient of the refuted six-coordinate shape is forced inside any computable per-ladder-state datum by the arithmetic of Count/Drift, but it is a coordinate of the carrier the set-valued datum D is computed over, with parameters that are outputs of the pumping lemma; D factors cellAt, the quotient alone does not. Exactness of D is obtained as the maximum certAdm-certified set, not by deciding generalized-Buchi nonemptiness.
